## File: google-deepmind_ai-foundations/ai_foundations/tokenization/bpe_tokenizer.py

Prompts

```
['create a BPEWordTokenizer that learns merge rules from a list of text strings with a specified number of merges', 'encode a text string into a list of token indices using the BPE tokenizer', 'decode a list of token IDs back into the original text string using the BPE tokenizer', 'split a text string into subword tokens using the learned BPE merge rules', 'load a pickled BPEWordTokenizer instance from a remote URL']
```

Usage

```
{'create_bpe_tokenizer_from_corpus': 'create a BPEWordTokenizer that learns merge rules from a list of text strings with a specified number of merges', 'encode_text_to_token_ids': 'encode a text string into a list of token indices using the BPE tokenizer', 'decode_token_ids_to_text': 'decode a list of token IDs back into the original text string using the BPE tokenizer', 'split_text_into_subword_tokens': 'split a text string into subword tokens using the learned BPE merge rules', 'load_tokenizer_from_url': 'load a pickled BPEWordTokenizer instance from a remote URL'}
```
